blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As the country marks World Teachers’ Day on Monday, the Department of Education (DepEd) recognized a community-based teacher in Pampanga for nearly two decades of work providing education to out-of-school youth and other underserved communities. Allan Delos Reyes, a Master Teacher II and Alternative Learning System (ALS) teacher at Minalin Elementary School in Pampanga, was among those honored. The DepEd Heroes ceremony took place last week at President Corazon C. Aquino National High School in Pasay City.
